entry.en: Your passport must be valid for the duration of your stay and have one blank page.
entry.es: Tu pasaporte debe ser válido durante toda la estancia y tener una página en blanco.
entry.quote:
Your passport must:  

- be valid for the duration of your stay 

- have one blank page

entry.en: You must be able to show proof of onward or return travel.
entry.es: Debes poder mostrar un billete de continuación o de regreso.
entry.quote: You must be able to show proof of onward or return travel.

entry.en: You must fill in the Mauritius All in One travel form online before you arrive and show a printed copy with a QR code at the airport.
entry.es: Debes rellenar en línea el formulario Mauritius All in One antes de llegar y mostrar una copia impresa con código QR en el aeropuerto.
entry.quote: You must fill in the Mauritius All in One travel form online before you arrive. Print out a copy of your completed form with a QR code on it.

entry.en: Without the form, you will be asked to fill in an immigration disembarkation card at the airport.
entry.es: Si no rellenas el formulario, te pedirán una tarjeta de desembarque de inmigración en el aeropuerto.
entry.quote: If you do not fill in the form before you arrive, you’ll be asked to fill in an immigration disembarkation card at the airport.

entry.en: Travellers from a country where malaria is common may be asked for a blood sample by border officials.
entry.es: A quienes llegan de un país donde la malaria es común, los agentes fronterizos pueden pedirles una muestra de sangre.
entry.quote: If you travel to Mauritius from a country where malaria is common, border officials may ask you for a blood sample to meet Ministry of Health requirements.

entry.en: Non-Mauritians without a work, residence, occupation, business or student permit who were in DRC or South Sudan in the previous 21 days are not allowed to enter.
entry.es: Los no mauricianos sin permiso de trabajo, residencia, ocupación, negocios o estudios que estuvieron en la RDC o Sudán del Sur en los 21 días previos no pueden entrar.
entry.quote: Non-Mauritian nationals that have travelled from Democratic Republic of Congo or South Sudan within the preceding 21 days and that do not hold a valid work permit, residence permit, occupation permit, business, or student visa are not allowed to enter Mauritius

safety.en: Localised demonstrations and community unrest have occurred in parts of Mauritius and may continue, with temporary evening and overnight curfews over most of the main island.
safety.es: Ha habido manifestaciones y disturbios locales en partes de Mauricio que pueden continuar, con toques de queda nocturnos en la mayor parte de la isla principal.
safety.quote: The Government of Mauritius has introduced temporary curfews during the evenings and overnight, covering most areas of the main island.

safety.en: Most crime is non-violent, such as burglaries from tourist villas or theft of unattended bags.
safety.es: La mayoría de los delitos no son violentos, como robos en villas turísticas o de bolsos desatendidos.
safety.quote: Most crime is non-violent such as burglaries from tourist villas or theft of unattended bags.

safety.en: Petty crime is common in tourist areas such as Port Louis, Grand Baie and Flic en Flac.
safety.es: Los delitos menores son comunes en zonas turísticas como Port Louis, Grand Baie y Flic en Flac.
safety.quote: Petty crime is common, particularly in tourist areas such as Port Louis, Grand Baie and Flic en Flac.

safety.en: Illegal drugs, including cannabis, carry severe penalties.
safety.es: Las drogas ilegales, incluido el cannabis, conllevan penas severas.
safety.quote: Illegal drugs, including cannabis, carry severe penalties.

safety.en: Same-sex sexual activity was decriminalised in October 2023, but LGBT+ people still face discrimination.
safety.es: La actividad sexual entre personas del mismo sexo se despenalizó en octubre de 2023, pero las personas LGBT+ aún sufren discriminación.
safety.quote: Same-sex sexual activity was decriminalised in October 2023. Mauritius is a relatively conservative society and local attitudes to the LGBT+ community vary across the country.

safety.en: The tropical cyclone season in Mauritius usually runs from November to May.
safety.es: La temporada de ciclones tropicales en Mauricio suele ir de noviembre a mayo.
safety.quote: The tropical cyclone season in Mauritius usually runs from November to May.

health.en: Good private healthcare is available but can be expensive, and complex cases may require evacuation to Réunion or South Africa.
health.es: Hay buena atención privada pero puede ser cara, y los casos complejos pueden requerir evacuación a Reunión o Sudáfrica.
health.quote: Good private healthcare is available but can be expensive. More complex cases may require evacuation to Réunion or South Africa.

health.en: To get an ambulance, call 999 or 114.
health.es: Para pedir una ambulancia, llama al 999 o al 114.
health.quote: Call 999 or 114 and ask for an ambulance.

health.en: Health risks include dengue, schistosomiasis and chikungunya.
health.es: Entre los riesgos sanitarios están el dengue, la esquistosomiasis y el chikungunya.
health.quote: See what health risks you’ll face on Mauritius, including:

health.en: You can bring common medicines for your own use but must carry a copy of the prescription.
health.es: Puedes llevar medicamentos comunes para uso propio, pero debes llevar copia de la receta.
health.quote: You can bring common medicines for your own use but you must carry a copy of the prescription.

health.en: Wikivoyage says tap water is generally considered potable, but bottled water is recommended for visitors not used to it.
health.es: Wikivoyage indica que el agua del grifo se considera generalmente potable, pero se recomienda agua embotellada para visitantes no acostumbrados.
health.quote: The tap water is generally considered potable and most Mauritians drink it, but for visitors who aren't used to it, bottled water is recommended.

health.en: Stonefish stings are rare but can be fatal, and urgent medical attention is needed.
health.es: Las picaduras de pez piedra son raras pero pueden ser mortales; hay que buscar atención médica urgente.
health.quote: Stonefish stings are rare but can be fatal. Get urgent medical attention if you are stung.

help.en: Emergency numbers are ambulance 999 or 114, fire 999 or 115, and police 999 or 112.
help.es: Los números de emergencia son ambulancia 999 o 114, bomberos 999 o 115 y policía 999 o 112.
help.quote:
Ambulance: 999 or 114

Fire: 999 or 115

Police: 999 or 112

help.en: Incidents can be reported to the tourist police on 999 or 112.
help.es: Los incidentes pueden denunciarse a la policía turística en el 999 o 112.

getting_in.en: Sir Seewoosagur Ramgoolam International Airport (MRU) is the major gateway for international travellers.
getting_in.es: El aeropuerto internacional Sir Seewoosagur Ramgoolam (MRU) es la principal puerta de entrada internacional.
getting_in.quote: It is the major gateway for international travellers.

getting_in.en: Air Mauritius is the home carrier, with routes to Africa, Australia, Europe and Asia.
getting_in.es: Air Mauritius es la aerolínea nacional, con rutas a África, Australia, Europa y Asia.
getting_in.quote: Air Mauritius is the home carrier and operates a network of routes to the local islands and international destinations in Africa, Australia, Europe and Asia.

getting_in.en: Vessels arriving at the port are mainly cargo ships.
getting_in.es: Los barcos que llegan al puerto son principalmente de carga.
getting_in.quote: Vessels that arrive at the port are mainly cargo ships.

getting_in.en: Visitors must give the immigration service the Mauritius All in One form, accommodation and return ticket details on arrival.
getting_in.es: Los visitantes deben dar a inmigración el formulario Mauritius All in One y datos del alojamiento y billete de vuelta al llegar.
getting_in.quote: visitors are required to provide a form called "Mauritius All in One", accommodation and return ticket details to the immigration service on arrival.

getting_around.en: The Metro Express light rail links Port Louis and Curepipe, with trains every 10 minutes from 6 AM to 7 PM.
getting_around.es: El tren ligero Metro Express une Port Louis y Curepipe, con trenes cada 10 minutos de 6 a 19 h.
getting_around.quote: Trains run every 10 minutes from 6 AM to 7 PM, taking around 40 minutes from end to end (Rs 50).

getting_around.en: Taking the bus is the most economical way of travelling, and as of 2023 a one-way fare costs MUR 44.
getting_around.es: El autobús es la forma más económica de viajar y, en 2023, un billete sencillo costaba 44 MUR.
getting_around.quote: Taking the bus is the most economical way of travelling. As of 2023 one way fare costs MUR 44.

getting_around.en: Taxis do not use meters, so negotiate the price before entering or you may be overcharged.
getting_around.es: Los taxis no usan taxímetro, así que hay que negociar el precio antes de subir o pueden cobrarte de más.
getting_around.quote: Taxis in Mauritius do not use meters. Negotiate the price of your trip before you enter a taxi; otherwise, you may be overcharged.

getting_around.en: Traffic drives on the left, and speed limits are 110 km/h on the motorway and 50 km/h in built-up areas.
getting_around.es: Se conduce por la izquierda, con límites de 110 km/h en autopista y 50 km/h en zonas urbanas.
getting_around.quote: Speed limits are 110 km/h (68 mph) on the motorway and 50 km/h (31 mph) in built-up areas.

getting_around.en: Air Mauritius operates daily flights between Plaisance Airport and Rodrigues, with a flight time of 1 hour 15 minutes.
getting_around.es: Air Mauritius opera vuelos diarios entre el aeropuerto de Plaisance y Rodrigues, de 1 hora 15 minutos.
getting_around.quote: Air Mauritius operates daily flights connecting Plaisance Airport and Rodrigues (flight time - 1 hour 15 minutes).

getting_around.en: Drink-driving is a serious offence, with penalties even at very low alcohol levels.
getting_around.es: Conducir bajo los efectos del alcohol es un delito grave, con sanciones incluso con niveles muy bajos.
getting_around.quote: Drink-driving is a serious offence in Mauritius.

money.en: The Mauritian rupee (MUR) is the currency, written with the symbol Rs.
money.es: La rupia mauriciana (MUR) es la moneda, con el símbolo Rs.
money.quote: The Mauritian rupee (French: roupie mauricienne) is denoted by the symbol "Rs." or "₨" with or without a full stop and placed before or after the amount (ISO international currency: MUR).

money.en: Many shops will not reduce prices, and even at markets you should not expect more than a 10-20% reduction.
money.es: Muchas tiendas no rebajan precios, y ni en los mercados se debe esperar más de un 10-20% de descuento.
money.quote: Many shops will not reduce prices, and even at the markets don't expect more than a 10-20% reduction.

connectivity.en: The main telecoms companies are Emtel and My.t, which sell SIM and eSIM cards at the airport from 700 MUR per month, and a passport is required.
connectivity.es: Las principales operadoras son Emtel y My.t, que venden SIM y eSIM en el aeropuerto desde 700 MUR al mes, y se requiere pasaporte.
connectivity.quote: They both sell sim card and E-sim at the airport from 700 MUR per month. Passport is required.
